definitions.name: NIST News
definitions.label: NIST 사이버보안
definitions.note: Agency-authored cybersecurity RSS text only, attribution NIST. Exclude copyright-marked third-party material, images, logos, full bodies and AI external processing. Date filter 2026-10-10 Asia/Seoul inclusive.

definitions.name: GitHub Advisory Database
definitions.label: 검토된 보안 취약점
definitions.note: GitHub Advisory Database CC BY 4.0. Attribution via source name, original advisory link and site terms link. Extractive summaries are modified excerpts; no endorsement. Reviewed, non-withdrawn advisories only; latest 30 per poll, not a complete vulnerability feed.

definitions.name: arXiv
definitions.label: 보안 취약점 논문
definitions.note: CC0 descriptive metadata (title/abstract/identifier) only; original abstract links, no PDF/body retrieval. Topic and submitted-date query, first 20 results, preprints not guaranteed peer-reviewed. Earlier topic queries excluded to reduce cross-feed duplicates. Official API authorization; no HTML crawling. Shared single-connection gate and 3-second cooldown.
